data.name: REWOUND
data.detailed_description:
REWOUND is a first-person VR narrative exploration game where players experience the world through the eyes of a black cat. Through object interaction and time-rewinding mechanics, players enter the collapsing memory world of Miles, a novelist living with Alzheimer’s disease, piecing together his forgotten life within constantly shifting spaces.

The game features a linear chapter-based narrative structure. Players explore environments across different periods of time, trigger fragmented memories, and observe spatial transformations. As time continues to rewind, the boundary between reality and memory gradually begins to blur.

Features:

• Immersive first-person VR narrative experience
• Time-rewinding and environmental exploration mechanics
• Memory-driven storytelling through shifting spaces
• Story progression through object interaction
• A psychological atmosphere centered around Alzheimer’s disease

Hello everyone! REWOUND is the first VR narrative game independently developed by a team of three undergraduate students. While it may not be perfect, we spent a long time carefully creating this story about memory and companionship. Thank you to everyone willing to experience it — we hope you enjoy the journey.

pc_requirements.minimum:
Minimum:
  • Requires a 64-bit processor and operating system
  • OS: Windows 10 64-bit
  • Processor: Intel i5-8400 / AMD Ryzen 5 2600
  • Memory: 8 GB RAM
  • Graphics: NVIDIA GTX 1060 6GB / AMD RX 580
  • DirectX: Version 11
  • Storage: 5 GB available space
  • VR Support: OpenXR compatible VR headset required. Supports SteamVR runtime. Tested with Pico 4 and Meta Quest headsets via PC streaming.
pc_requirements.recommended:
Recommended:
  • Requires a 64-bit processor and operating system
  • OS: Windows 11 64-bit
  • Processor: i7-10700
  • Memory: 16 MB RAM
  • Graphics: RTX 3060
  • DirectX: Version 12
  • Storage: 8 MB available space
  • VR Support: OpenXR compatible VR headset required. Supports SteamVR runtime. Tested with Pico 4 and Meta Quest headsets via PC streaming.
